policy: Public discoverability is not permission to download, redistribute, or use data. Each dataset requires license/terms review, source version pinning, payload hashes, privacy review, and train/test split review before ingestion.

entries.title: FGI Jammertest 2025 GNSS interference dataset
entries.publisher: Finnish Geospatial Research Institute via Etsin
entries.summary: SBF and RINEX receiver observations, metadata, corrections, and ground truth. The listing describes two unintentional-interference scenarios, five jamming, six spoofing, two meaconing, and five mixed scenarios.
entries.recommended_use: Primary held-out event and receiver-group evaluation after rights review.

entries.title: GNSS Dataset Under Jamming, Spoofing, and Meaconing Conditions (JammerTest 2024)
entries.summary: Recorded stationary and dynamic receiver data with associated navigation and monitoring material for a controlled research campaign.
entries.recommended_use: Secondary external-event evaluation; avoid mixing adjacent windows from one event across train and test.

entries.title: FGI GNSS Spoofing Dataset Repository
entries.summary: Repository describing public GNSS jamming/spoofing datasets, including modernized Galileo-related research material. Exact constituent dataset versions and terms must be recorded before use.
entries.recommended_use: Additional external generalization set after source-level licensing and label review.

entries.title: Implementation and performance analysis of a Chi-Square Test based GNSS signal anomaly detection
entries.summary: Published statistical anomaly-detection baseline evaluated across public datasets and a Jammertest campaign. Reproduction conditions and data availability must be verified before comparison.
entries.recommended_use: Statistical comparator; do not infer equivalence from abstract-level descriptions.

entries.title: Multicriteria Collaborative GNSS Integrity Monitoring
entries.publisher: IEEE Journal of Indoor and Seamless Positioning and Navigation
entries.summary: Published study of collaborative integrity monitoring using multiple receiver observations. Reported data mix and evaluation conditions must be matched before comparison.
entries.recommended_use: Cross-receiver consistency comparator, with the caveat that study results do not establish production performance.
